1. Cont Lens Anterior Eye. 2023 Apr;46(2):101754. doi:
10.1016/j.clae.2022.101754.  Epub 2022 Sep 27.

Secondary pigmentary glaucoma following cosmetic laser treatment to alter iris 
colour.

Swampillai AJ(1), Sherman T(1), Garg A(1), Tan IJ(1), Sheng Lim K(2).

Author information:
(1)Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust, London, UK.
(2)Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust, London, UK. Electronic address: 
sheng.lim@gstt.nhs.uk.

Cosmetic alteration of iris colour with implants, along with its secondary 
complications, is already well described in the literature. However the use of 
cosmetic iris laser is relatively novel. We report on a rare case of bilateral 
secondary pigmentary glaucoma, in a young patient who underwent such a treatment 
to cause a change in iris pigmentation. Data on the safety of such procedures 
are lacking. Ophthalmic healthcare professionals should be aware of the 
potentially devastating consequences and encourage caution in patients seeking 
this novel treatment.
